clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau isn't a pork absolutist. He grew up Italian eating pork, and says no one's going to die from it.

But he ran his own test: cut pork for three months, to see how he'd feel.

At first, nothing changed. Then he ordered pork chops at a restaurant known for them, and didn't enjoy them like before, and felt sluggish after.

His takeaway: you don't have to swear it off forever. Go without it a while, then notice how your body responds when it's back.

Comment HEALTH for his full take on meat and energy.
